name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region
provider: University Grants Commission (UGC), Government of India
unchecked_criteria: Parents' annual income must be below Rs 4.5 lakh; an income of exactly Rs 4.5 lakh or more is not eligible

Must have passed Class 12 (or equivalent, from a recognized board including CBSE, ICSE or NIOS) from a school in the North Eastern Region, and hold a valid domicile certificate of a North Eastern state
Must be admitted to the first year of your first undergraduate degree in regular full-time mode; open, distance, correspondence and part-time students are not eligible
Students admitted through the management quota are not eligible

Must study at an eligible institution (UGC Act Section 2(f) universities and colleges, deemed universities, fully Central or State funded degree-awarding institutions, or Institutions of National Importance)
Only one scholarship or monetary benefit at a time; if you already receive another, you must declare it and give it up if selected
Aadhaar-linked, KYC-compliant bank account in your own name is required
benefit: Rs 8,000 per month for 10 months a year (Rs 80,000 per year), paid by DBT, through the whole first undergraduate degree subject to good conduct, attendance and promotion. About 10,000 scholarships a year, split 50-50 between arts/humanities/social sciences/law/management and science/engineering/medical/technical/agriculture/forestry. Selection is state-wise merit on Class 12 marks.
documents: Domicile certificate or Permanent Resident Certificate of a North Eastern state
Income certificate issued by the competent authority
Admission and bonafide details from the institution
source_text: PASTE THE EXACT ELIGIBILITY PASSAGE FROM THE UGC ISHAN UDAY GUIDELINE HERE
